verdict.rationale: There is no first-party PR review feature in the evidence. The only path is a DIY one: the headless CLI can be scripted into CI pipelines with machine-readable output (antigravity-docs-50), and custom skills or hooks could steer a review (antigravity-docs-20, antigravity-docs-21). The Review Changes diff viewer and Artifact comments are for humans reviewing the agent's own work, not automated review of pull requests. Missing for 10: a native automatic PR review integration (e.g., GitHub/GitLab app or action), posting contextual inline comments on PRs, triggering on every PR, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
